name: Sita Enterprises Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1982, Sita Enterprises Ltd        
is in the business of investment and finance.
keyPoints:
Registration:[1]
Company is a Non Banking Finance Company registered with Reserve Bank of India as a non-systematic important NBFC not accepting / holding public deposits. Company is also classified as an Investment and Credit Company (NBFC-ICC) in accordance with RBI guidelines

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -3.24%
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.22% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 11.2% over last 3 years.
